responsibility: Implements the low-level system storage backend for GNU Modula-2 boot code, providing heap allocation, deallocation, reallocation, and availability checks directly on top of `libc_malloc`, `libc_free`, and `libc_realloc`. It also owns the optional debug/zeroing behavior controlled by environment variables and the module init/fini hooks used to seed those runtime flags, making it the platform-facing memory primitive beneath the higher `Storage` wrapper.
same_name_distinction: Contains the working storage backend built on libc_malloc/libc_free/libc_realloc, plus trace/zeroing environment handling in module init, whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/GSysStorage.h is only the interface declaration for those allocation routines.
